details.name: Determining When a Student Fails a Course (Case 1)
details.description: Construct a program to determine whether a student fails the course based on the inputs that it receives from the instructor. The student fails the course if the exam score is less than 55 or student has more than 2 missing homework.

details.name: Determining When a Student Fails a Course (Case 2)
details.description: Construct a program that determines whether a student fails the course based on the inputs that it receives from the instructor. The student fails the course if the exam score is less than 55 or when the student has cheated.

details.name: Determining When a Student Fails a Course (Case 3)
details.description: Construct a program that determines whether a student fails the course based on the inputs that it receives from the instructor. The student fails the course if his/her score is not above the class average.
